detail.longDescription:
I’ve been building this on and off for the past year - it started because I got
tired of “free” PDF tools that upload your files to who-knows-where or watermark
page 2. Everything runs client-side: a PDF suite (edit/merge/split/sign/OCR),
image and audio converters, 200+ calculators, and some AI tools that lean on
local models where possible. No accounts, no file size gates, and it works
offline once installed (PWA). The webdev-relevant bits: most of the heavy
lifting is WASM (ffmpeg.wasm, tesseract), plus service workers for offline.
Honestly the hardest part was memory management on large files in Safari. Would
genuinely like feedback - especially on what tools are missing. If you want to
poke at the audio/video side, https://practicalwebtools.com/studio
[https://practicalwebtools.com/studio] is the fun part.
